extends.description: Declare template inheritance from a parent template. The child template may override blocks defined by the parent.
extends.caveat: The extends tag must appear before any output, except whitespace or comments.

from.syntax: {% from template import name1, name2 as alias with context %}
from.description: Import specific macros or variables from another template into the current namespace.
from.caveat: Only explicitly imported names are available. Aliases should not shadow existing variables.

set.syntax: {% set name = value %} | {% set name %}...{% endset %}
set.description: Assign a value to a variable within the template. Supports both single-line assignment and block assignment.
set.caveat: Assignments are scoped to the current context. Block assignments capture rendered text, not expressions.

block.description: Define a named block that can be overridden by child templates during template inheritance.
block.caveat: Block names must be unique within a template.

trans.description: Mark text for translation using Jinja's i18n extension.
trans.caveat: Source extraction preserves this tag after i18n AST lowering.

if.syntax: {% if condition %}...{% elif condition %}...{% else %}...{% endif %}
if.description: Conditionally render blocks based on the truth value of expressions.
if.caveat: Conditions follow Python truthiness rules: empty sequences, empty strings, None, and 0 evaluate to False.

call.description: Invoke a macro and pass a block of template content as a callable via the special caller() function.
call.caveat: The macro must explicitly call caller() to render the block. Call blocks introduce additional rendering overhead.

macro.description: Define a reusable template function that can accept arguments and return rendered output.
macro.caveat: Macros perform no type checking. Variables defined inside a macro are local. Recursive macros may cause stack overflows.
